Moody National Bank Trust Division sold 2,805 shares as the company’s stock rose 5.37% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 34,368 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $5.77M, down from 37,173 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Moody National Bank Trust Division who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $937.32B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.82% or $1.58 $190.7.
